title: [searchBox] Powered by
body:
Based on this issue ( https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/25 ), I'm not sure anymore that the search input will be a widget, but if it is, it could be great to embed the "Powered by" with it, enabled by default.

What do you think?

comments.body: It is a widget and I think it'll stay that way. Why not adding the option :)
Dunno if it should be enabled by defaultm especially for paying customers it might feel weird
well activated by default is not great yeah. But the option would be useful to avoid people that don't have the time to invest on adding an algolia :) No excuse :)
You're right, it makes sense only on integrations where this can be relayed to the configuration panel.
it's definitely something we need to have to ease our community plan. We could also have it in the Stats widget.
I would put it by default but with an easy option to turn it off (directly from the widget for manual install, but also from the dashboard of our magento-like implementations)
